quick_skim.title: PIC: Revisiting INR for Image Coding with Fast Encoding and Sub-Millisecond Decoding
quick_skim.abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis and image/video coding in recent years.Compared to conventional end-to-end image codecs, INR-based compressors demonstrate significant advantages in decoding complexity. However, their practical application has been hindered by the inferior encoding speed and underutilized decoding efficiency.In this work, we propose a feedforward INR image coding architecture, Practical INR Image Codec (PIC), that computes all the necessary information for INR network in a single forward pass, achieving an encoding speed of 20 FPS. Additionally, we implement a highly optimized decoder that reaches 2000 FPS decoding speed, significantly surpassing JPEG's performance at comparable rate-distortion (RD) performance. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first learning-based image codec that simultaneously outperforms or is comparable with JPEG in both RD performance and decoding speed while maintaining practical encoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes PIC, a feedforward INR image codec computing all INR network information in one forward pass, reaching 20 FPS encoding and 2000 FPS decoding, surpassing JPEG and prior INR codecs in practicality.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对INR图像编码器虽解码复杂度低，但编码速度慢且解码效率未被充分利用的问题，论文提出前馈式INR图像编码架构PIC，在单次前向传播中计算INR网络所需的全部信息，并实现高度优化的解码器。实验显示其编码速度达20FPS，解码速度达2000FPS，显著超越JPEG等编解码器的实用性。该工作为端到端神经编解码的低复杂度与高效部署提供了可行方案，对轻量化编码器设计具有借鉴价值。
